name: @kotoba-lang/envelope
description: npm deps of the CLJS half. X25519 and HKDF come through kotoba-lang/org-signal; ML-KEM-768 is imported directly by envelope.kem and envelope.qualify.
comment: These were devDependencies until 2026-09-06 and that was wrong in a way that only shows up off this machine: src/envelope/kem.cljk and src/envelope/qualify.cljk import @noble/post-quantum, so it is a runtime dependency of those namespaces, not a development convenience. It matters because the fleet gate runs `npm install --omit=dev`, which installs nothing, EXITS 0, and leaves the suite to fail on a missing module -- the gate script has a whole function (npm-declared) devoted to catching exactly that trap. @noble/post-quantum is pinned exactly because envelope.qualify binds its module digest; a range there makes the deployed provider unmeasured. @noble/curves is held at 1.x because org-signal's x25519 calls utils.randomPrivateKey, which 2.x renamed.
